blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: Curcumin is the major bioactive component found in the roots of turmeric (Curcuma longa). Curcumin has been extensively researched for its free radical neutralizing and immune system supporting activities. This product features a combination of curcumin and BioPerine®, a black pepper extract, that has been shown in clinical studies to enhance absorption.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Take 1 capsule 1 to 2 times daily with food.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Hypromellose (cellulose capsule), calcium laurate and silicon dioxide.
Not manufactured with yeast, wheat, gluten, soy, milk, egg, fish, shellfish, tree nut or sesame ingredients.
Produced in a GMP facility that processes other ingredients containing these allergens.
Made and quality tested in the USA with globally sourced ingredients.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Store in a cool, dry place after opening.

For adults only. Consult physician if pregnant/ nursing, taking medication (especially anticoagulants or anti-platelet drugs), have a medical condition, or have any history of liver, gall bladder, or gastrointestinal problems. Keep out of reach of children.
Natural color variation may occur in this product.
